rows.removalTrigger: The skill playbooks ceasing to document CLI invocation at all. This module's `verbsMissingFromSkills()` asserts a relation between the dispatch switch's own verbs and the literal token `anno <verb>` in skill prose; once no skill file names an invocation, the relation has no right-hand side and the module -- with `scripts/check-skill-tool-coverage.mjs`'s verb half -- should be removed rather than left asserting over an empty corpus.
rows.note: Plant target is the INVOCATION LITERAL in `verbsMissingFromSkills()` (`anno ${verb}` -> `anno-${verb}`), deliberately NOT the `ANNO_CLI_VERB_FLOOR` constant the tracer row (`src/mcp/vice/r2000-verb-coverage.test.ts`) already plants. The two rows therefore share a plant FILE but not a plant TARGET and not a guard: the tracer runs `node --test anno-verb-coverage.test.ts`, this row runs the live CI script `scripts/check-skill-tool-coverage.mjs`. Neither can mask the other -- the floor mutation trips an arithmetic non-vacuity assertion, this one trips the skill-coverage relation, and they fail through different code paths. Expected to trip: the verb-coverage relation, reporting every real verb as undocumented because the token the predicate matches no longer matches the token the playbooks carry.

The guard is therefore `npm run typecheck` in `src/mcp/vice`, and the plant removes one of the three exported declarations. Expected to trip: `src/mcp/vice/anno-verb-coverage.test.ts:24` imports `verbsMissingFromSkills` from `../../../scripts/lib/anno-cli-verbs.mjs`, which TypeScript resolves through this `.d.mts`; with the declaration gone the import has no exported member and `tsc --noEmit` errors. Note that `skipLibCheck: true` suppresses checking INSIDE declaration files but not export resolution against them, which is exactly the check this plant exercises. GUARD ARGV DEVIATION (recorded, not hidden): the harness's third documented convention, `argv: ["--run", "typecheck"]`, spawns `npm --run typecheck`, and npm 11 rejects that form (`Unknown command: "typecheck"`; it wants `npm run typecheck`). Measured here: the UNPLANTED control exited 1 with that message, so the row came back UNMEASURABLE rather than red -- the green-control rule doing exactly its job, refusing to let a broken invocation be recorded as evidence. This plan modifies no script, so the route around it is the harness's OTHER convention: spawn `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`, which is byte-for-byte the command `package.json`'s `typecheck` script runs.
